meta.provenance_note: Codebook-only prompt v1.3.1; temperature not API-controlled in this harness.

premises.text: Plant-parasitic nematodes destroy a large share of crops each year
premises.evidence_span: farmers lose roughly 12% of their crops every year to plant parasitic nematodes

premises.text: Demand for safe, eco-friendly pest control and residue regulation pushes farmers to alternatives
premises.evidence_span: consumers are demanding safe and eco-friendly pest control used on their foods

premises.text: Pheromones control nematode behaviors such as dispersal, enabling directed pest control
premises.evidence_span: This gives us the power to control nematodes. One such behavior is dispersal

premises.text: Ferrocote seed treatment protects young roots by directing parasitic nematodes away
premises.evidence_span: Ferrocote is a seed treatment that is applied to seeds before they are planted, and it protects the young and vulnerable roots from attack by plant parasitic nematodes

premises.text: Nemastim increases effectiveness of beneficial nematodes used as insect biocontrols
premises.evidence_span: Nemastim makes beneficial nematodes up to 200% more effective

domains.name: Crop loss and eco-friendly pest demand

value.text: Eco-friendly nematode control so farmers can grow more food
value.evidence_span: Our eco-friendly products control nematodes, so farmers can grow more food

causal_links.evidence_span: We've taken this technology and used it to create our first two products

notes: Ends mid partner/fundraising ask. Co-founder bio excluded; pheromone mechanism coded. Ferrocote and Nemastim kept separate as distinct product paths.
